svg.title: IFCOM+ — Client Registration and Approval
svg.desc: Draft Agent-initiated BPMN. Three sibling responsibility lanes, duplicate prevention and Manager approval. Orange elements are proposals. The 48-hour reminder is non-interrupting and ends independently. Approval policy remains open.

text.tspan: OQ-001: confirm the company matching key.
OQ-004: define the approval review view.
OQ-005: define self-approval / segregation of duties.
OQ-007: confirm final registration state names and
OQ-006 / OQ-007: define rejection, correction, resubmission and final
Draft analytical model · Agent-initiated case · proposed behavior remains unapproved
